name: Dried banana
summary: A chewy dried banana on the district OCOP list. The rural desk names chuối sấy dẻo as a gift. It is not the seeded banana VnExpress sells on the path to Ao Tien.
origin: Ba Be district. Vietnam Tourism's rural desk.
howToEat: Buy it at the counter. A piece count was not printed.
A price is Check on arrival. The counter hour is Check on arrival.
where: The OCOP counters at Chợ Rã and Nam Mẫu.
seoDescription: Chuối sấy dẻo, an OCOP gift at Chợ Rã and Nam Mẫu. A price is Check on arrival.
